_about: The "while you were away" note, shown when you come back: an opener for how long you were gone, then a line about one cat, on the same page.
The cats' lines are in each cat's file in content/moments (the "away" part), so a new cat brings its own.
gaps: names for how long you were gone, shortest first; under_hours is where each ends (the last one is for anything longer).
long_from_hours: from this many hours, the cats' "long" lines are used instead of the "short" ones.
second_page_chance: how often (0 to 1) a second page adds a small change in the café, for gaps from second_page_from and longer.
changes: from is the shortest gap a change fits.
Keep the opener and a cat line together under about 3 lines of 46 letters.

openers.text: You've been gone a few hours.
A few hours have gone by.
The light has changed since you left.
It's been a day or so.
You were here not long ago.
A few days since your last visit.
You've been away for some time.
It's been a long time. The café is just as you left it.

changes.text: Someone has wiped your table. It still smells faintly of lemon.
The candle on your table is new. The old one burned all the way down.
Someone has put your book back on your table, the bookmark where you last left it.
The chalkboard has been rubbed out and written again, in Nala's handwriting.
The cushions in the cat bed have been plumped up. The cats are already flattening them.
There's a new book on the shelf. Nala must have been by.
The menu on the chalkboard has changed a little. The prices haven't.
Someone has moved the lamp on the sideboard. The cats have already moved it back.
The ivy on the bookcase has grown a little since you were last here.
The cat bed has a new cushion. Nobody has dared to sit on it yet.
Your chair is exactly where you left it. Someone made sure of that.
